semantic_grouping.method: Read all 153 saved phrase groups; exact transcript sequence and renderer semantic validation; three measured forced-width exceptions personally consulted.

audible_sync.method: Local forced alignment compared to provider duration-corrected character map only; no human listening performed.
audible_sync.coverage: 544 spoken words machine comparison: median absolute start delta 35 ms, p95 201.85 ms, max 521 ms; punctuation dash excluded.

visual_placement.method: All 44 source scenes viewed full-frame; 44 mid-scene composites viewed in four contact sheets. Full-size S01, S17, S35 mids; revised S17/S35 start, middle and end personally viewed. Crop bounds validated at 132 samples. Caption renderer measured every phrase width.
visual_placement.coverage: 44 source images, 44 midpoint overview samples; targeted 7 full-size composites. 132 bounds samples are machine evidence, not 132 personal views.
